replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I do get anxious when I encounter math problems—especially when they’re complex or unfamiliar. It’s not about intelligence, but about feeling overwhelmed. I tend to avoid problems that seem too hard, which makes me feel like I’m falling behind.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using a simple AI tool last year to check my homework. It helped me understand basic concepts, but I found it too simplistic and sometimes gave wrong answers. I didn’t trust it fully, especially when it came to word problems.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance.
